## Maps and Tokens for Chapter 4

Session 4 is a single continuous dungeon crawl across three maps. Load all three before
players join; reposition tokens room-by-room on the middle map rather than reloading it
between scenes.

### Scene → Map → Tokens

| Scene | Map File | Tokens to Place | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Scene 0: The Marsh | `Maptool/maps/dicegrimorium/SkeletonFortressEntrance/Skeleton Fortress Entrance Public/SkeletonFortressEntrancePublic.jpg` | All PCs, [Banshee](https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/16799-banshee) ×3 | Banshees (*MM* p. 23, CR 4, AC 12, HP 58) rise mid-causeway. Staggered Wails across rounds. |
| Scene 1: The Ossuary | `Maptool/maps/dicegrimorium/BloodCultDungeon/Blood Cult Dungeon Public/Blood-Cult-Dungeon-Gridded-29x43-MapPublic.jpg` (west skull room) | All PCs, [Bone Naga](https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/16812-bone-naga) ×2, [Skeleton](https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/17015-skeleton) ×4 | Nagas (*MM* p. 233, CR 4, AC 15, HP 58) + 4 Skeletons (*MM* p. 272, CR 1/4, AC 13, HP 13). Both vulnerable to bludgeoning. |
| Scene 2: The Blood-Growth Rooms | Same map, east rooms | All PCs, [Yochlol](https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/17068-yochlol) ×1, [Dretch](https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/16847-dretch) ×2 | Yochlol (*MM* p. 65, CR 6, AC 15, HP 136) + Dretches (*MM* p. 57, CR 1/4, AC 11, HP 18, Fetid Cloud). |
| Scene 3: The Minor Altar | Same map, center room | All PCs, [Shadow Demon](https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/17010-shadow-demon) ×3 | Shadow Demons (*MM* p. 64, CR 4, AC 13, HP 66, vuln radiant). 4 Braziers puzzle: lighting them strips stealth and activates Sunlight Weakness. |
| Scene 4: The Rune Lock | Same map, south of center | All PCs (no combat tokens by default) | The room with the 4 glowing sigil tiles. Optional Dretch ambush if pacing needs it. |
| Scene 5: The Gathering Hall | Same map, south end | All PCs, [Wraith](https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/17064-wraith) ×3 | Chieftains (*MM* p. 302, CR 5, AC 13, HP 67). Life Drain, Incorporeal Movement, Sunlight Sensitivity. |
| Scene 6: The Core Room | `Maptool/maps/dicegrimorium/CastleCoreRoom/Castle Core Room Public/CastleCoreRoomPublic.jpg` | All PCs, [Glabrezu](https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/16870-glabrezu) ×1 | Glabrezu (*MM* p. 58, CR 9, AC 17, HP 157). Multiattack, Innate Spellcasting, Magic Resistance. Long Rest into Lvl 7. |

### NPC Tokens

No allied NPCs travel with the party this session:
- **Tribune Lucius is deceased** (fell in Session 3) — the contubernium travels alone, carrying his locked iron box.
- **Centurion Varro is deceased** (killed in Session 3 cold open).
- **Legate Corvinus and Augur Cassia** stayed behind to secure Fort Vindolanda.

Do not place any garrison NPC tokens.

### Map Files Location

These three maps are not yet copied into a campaign session folder --
`build_campaign_maps.sh` needs a new S4 block matching this session's actual content
(see below). Source files:

```
Maptool/maps/dicegrimorium/SkeletonFortressEntrance/Skeleton Fortress Entrance Public/SkeletonFortressEntrancePublic.jpg
Maptool/maps/dicegrimorium/BloodCultDungeon/Blood Cult Dungeon Public/Blood-Cult-Dungeon-Gridded-29x43-MapPublic.jpg
Maptool/maps/dicegrimorium/CastleCoreRoom/Castle Core Room Public/CastleCoreRoomPublic.jpg
```

Run `bash Maptool/maps/build_campaign_maps.sh` to copy session tokens into the campaign
folder (idempotent) once the S4 block below is added.

### Required build_campaign_maps.sh changes (S4 block)

The current S4 block still copies old siege-era assets (`s4_fort_siege.html`, the tunnel
SVGs, `NatureGoddessTemple`, Berserker/Tribal_Warrior/Legionary crowds, Quintus_Flavius,
Cultist_of_Mars). All of that is obsolete for this session's actual content. Replace with:

```bash
# Dice Grimorium / custom maps for the Blood Cult Dungeon
cp "$DG/SkeletonFortressEntrance/Skeleton Fortress Entrance Public/SkeletonFortressEntrancePublic.jpg" "$S/"
cp "$DG/BloodCultDungeon/Blood Cult Dungeon Public/Blood-Cult-Dungeon-Gridded-29x43-MapPublic.jpg" "$S/"
cp "$DG/CastleCoreRoom/Castle Core Room Public/CastleCoreRoomPublic.jpg" "$S/"

# Creatures
for slug in Banshee Bone_Naga Skeleton Yochlol Dretch Shadow_Demon Wraith Glabrezu; do
  copy_npc "$slug" "$S"
done
```

This is deliberate design work for Story 8.8, not yet applied to the actual script --
apply it as its own commit once confirmed.
